title: Today Thy Mercy Calls Me
description: Today Thy Mercy Calls Me in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Oswald Allen, first published in 1861. The tune, ANTHES, is by Friedrich Konrad Anthes (1847). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: To-day Thy mer-cy calls me to wash a-way my sin; How-ev-er great my tres-pass, wha-te'er I may have been; How-ev-er long from mer-cy I may have turned a-way, Thy blood, O Christ, can wash me, and make me clean to-day.

lines: Thy blood, O Christ, can wash me,
No question will be asked me,
What shall I do without thee
when heart and eyes run o'er?
When all things seem against me,
I know one gate is open,
one ear will hear my prayer.

topics: God's Children - the Faithful (see also Saints, People of the World)
